# Agatha Sowerby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** Widowed  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Agatha is a stout woman whose walk is described as a perpetual waddle. She sits by her kitchen window watching the main road in Brierley and knitting quilts.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)_

## Personality

Agatha is an exceptionally inquisitive, industrious, and opinionated busybody who directs the affairs of her neighbors while efficiently managing her own home. She takes pride in speaking her mind freely without fear or partiality, though her bluntness can come across as intrusive and harsh. Despite her sharp tongue and rigid views, she possesses a kind heart and shows quiet tenderness and devotion when nursing the sick.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P15](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0015), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P1](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0001), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

- Maintain order, propriety, and church affairs in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## History

Agatha Sowerby lived in Sowerby's Hollow in Brierley, serving as a pillar of the local church organizations, including the Sewing Circle, Sunday-school, Church Aid Society, and Foreign Missions Auxiliary. When Obed Abernethy brought the orphan girl Nell home to Grey Shutters, Agatha was quick to disapprove and later insulted Nell's looks, prompting a furious outburst from the girl that led to Nell offering a dramatic apology. Over the years, Agatha continued to keep a close eye on community affairs, raising money for church causes, organizing events, and commenting on local developments. When her quiet husband Thomas fell ill, she cared for him tenderly until his death. Following his passing, she sold her excess household items and moved into the renovated spare room at Grey Shutters to reside with Thirza Abernethy. She later traveled to Seven Gulls with Thirza and the twins to celebrate Christmas with the newly married Hugh and Nell, bringing along a plum pudding she had baked.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c1 P21](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0021), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c10 P29](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0029), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000), [v4 c15 P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 c15 P2](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Raised ten children with her husband Thomas Sowerby  <sub>[v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v4 c4 P12](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0012)</sub>
- Lived near Sowerby's Hollow opposite Grey Shutters lane for forty-five years as Thirza Abernethy's neighbor  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017)</sub>
- Harbors a strong prejudice against Americans due to a Boston boss defrauding her husband of ten dollars  <sub>[v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048)</sub>
